sql: SELECT "player_award_vote"."player_id" AS e, "player"."death_country" AS g, AVG((CAST(("player_award_vote"."points_won" - "player_award_vote"."points_max") AS REAL) / "player_award_vote"."points_max")) AS m1 FROM "player_award_vote" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "player_award_vote"."player_id"  GROUP BY "player_award_vote"."player_id", "player"."death_country" ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: player_award_vote.relative difference of voting points won from maximum possible points
why: (voting points won - maximum possible points) / maximum possible points: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of voting points won from maximum possible points per player within player.death_country

sql: SELECT "player"."throws" AS g, SUM("player_award_vote"."votes_first") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("player_award_vote"."points_won" - "player_award_vote"."points_max") AS REAL) / "player_award_vote"."points_max")) AS m2 FROM "player_award_vote" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "player_award_vote"."player_id" GROUP BY "player"."throws"

why: total of first-place votes per player.throws (additive)

sql: SELECT "hall_of_fame"."player_id" AS e, "player"."throws" AS g, AVG("hall_of_fame"."votes") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("hall_of_fame"."ballots" - "hall_of_fame"."needed") AS REAL) / "hall_of_fame"."needed")) AS m2 FROM "hall_of_fame" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "hall_of_fame"."player_id"  GROUP BY "hall_of_fame"."player_id", "player"."throws" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10

sql: SELECT "batting_postseason"."player_id" AS e, "player"."bats" AS g, SUM(("batting_postseason"."so" - "batting_postseason"."triple")) AS m1, AVG(("batting_postseason"."g" - "batting_postseason"."r")) AS m2, (SUM(("batting_postseason"."so" - "batting_postseason"."triple")) - AVG(("batting_postseason"."g" - "batting_postseason"."r"))) AS m3 FROM "batting_postseason" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "batting_postseason"."player_id"  GROUP BY "batting_postseason"."player_id", "player"."bats" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
